properties.name: Great Falls & Potomac Gorge (Northern Virginia)
properties.description: The Potomac Gorge just upriver of Washington, D.C.: Great Falls Park on the Virginia bank (an NPS site administered under the George Washington Memorial Parkway), the dramatic falls and Mather Gorge, and the River/Difficult Run trails down toward the Beltway. Includes Fairfax County's Riverbend Park and Scott's Run Nature Preserve, with the C&O Canal towpath and Great Falls Tavern visible across the river on the Maryland side. Rocky river-gorge singletrack with real relief above the water.
properties.bbox_comment: [west, south, east, north] in decimal degrees (WGS84). Covers the VA-side gorge corridor from Riverbend (N) past Great Falls Park down toward Chain Bridge (S), plus the near MD bank (C&O towpath) across the river.
properties.origins_comment: Named search origins the frontend picker offers for this region (Phase 2: config-driven — adding/removing an origin is a config edit, not a frontend deploy). key is the wire/UI identifier; lat/lon WGS84.
properties.min_fetch_counts_comment: Per-source raw-fetch floors (a source fetching below its floor aborts the run BEFORE any load/prune — a truncated/partial fetch can't self-wipe). Only OSM (geometry) is floor-gated here; NPS/USGS are enrichment (USGS is 3DEP elevation and never fetches). This floor is a CONSERVATIVE pre-calibration estimate — this config-only lane cannot run a live Overpass fetch, so unlike the pilot regions there is no measured baseline yet. Recalibrate to ~70% of the measured live baseline after the first successful ingest. Env-overridable via ADVENTURE_FETCH_MIN_OSM.
